patterns.note: Full-bleed hero video with a dark red overlay sets a dramatic, immersive tone for the initial view.
Extremely oversized, blocky sans-serif typography is used for the main brand name and section headings, creating a bold, almost architectural presence.
A high-contrast palette of deep red, black, and white is used consistently to define sections and highlight key information.
The prominent 'THE LINE' hero text dynamically changes color from white to black as it scrolls up and transitions over a white background section.
The top navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay with white text to a solid white background with black text and a red accent dot upon scrolling down.
Content sections often feature asymmetrical layouts or angled graphic elements, such as the red block in the 'Highlights' section, adding dynamic visual interest.

technique_notes: A full-width video background with a semi-transparent color overlay is used in the hero section to create an immediate, high-impact visual experience, with large, contrasting text placed on top.

The main navigation bar is initially transparent and fixed to the top, then transitions to a solid background with updated text colors and a subtle accent indicator once the user scrolls past the hero section.
Large display text elements are designed to change color based on their scroll position, specifically when they overlap different background colors, creating a dynamic visual reveal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, blocky display headings (~4-5x body text) with a clean, balanced sans-serif for body and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy in hero and between major sections, with balanced density in content grids.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, cinematic aesthetic, driven by the dramatic full-bleed red video hero and the massive, color-changing typography. This creates an immediate, high-impact brand statement that feels both modern and artistic, setting it apart from typical agency sites.
